---
title: "S3 - Catchment table and command area"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("R/00_utils/notebook_setup.R")
```

**Stage:** S3 (catchment table).
**Purpose:** fix one command area and one claim volume per gauge, so that
demand and supply are expressed in the *same* claims/day unit. This is the
unit wall that removes the v1 unit-mix defect (F1/U1/U2).
**Inputs:** `output/catchment_table.csv`, `output/selected_gauges.csv`.
**Outputs:** none.
**Parameters:** `P$d_mm` (claim depth 20 mm), `P$f_irr` (irrigated fraction).

## Load and check the unit wall

```{r}
ct <- nb_require("catchment_table.csv", "S3")
sel <- nb_require("selected_gauges.csv", "S3")
nb_assert_cols(ct,
  c("gauge_id", "basin", "area_km2", "area_m2", "lat", "lon", "f_irr",
    "area_cmd_m2", "area_source", "district_id", "claim_m3"),
  "catchment table")
nb_assert_cols(sel, c("gauge_id", "basin", "rho", "n_train", "n_test"),
               "selected gauges")

# area_m2 is the catchment; area_cmd_m2 is f_irr * catchment
nb_assert(all(abs(ct$area_m2 - ct$area_km2 * 1e6) < 1e-6),
          "area_m2 must equal area_km2 * 1e6")
nb_assert(all(abs(ct$area_cmd_m2 - ct$f_irr * ct$area_m2) < 1),
          "area_cmd_m2 must equal f_irr * area_m2")
nb_assert(all(abs(ct$claim_m3 - (P$d_mm / 1000) * ct$area_cmd_m2) < 1),
          "claim_m3 must equal (d/1000) * area_cmd_m2")
knitr::kable(ct[, .(gauge_id, basin, area_km2, f_irr,
                    area_cmd_m2, claim_m3 = signif(claim_m3, 4),
                    district_name)],
             digits = 1, caption = "Analysis catchment table (one claim volume per gauge)")
```

## Selected gauges (G3 funnel)

```{r}
cat(sprintf("selected: %d gauges across %d basins\n",
            nrow(sel), data.table::uniqueN(sel$basin)))
cat(sprintf("utilisation rho range: %.3f to %.3f (window %.2f-%.2f)\n",
            min(sel$rho), max(sel$rho), P$rho_window[1], P$rho_window[2]))
nb_assert(nrow(sel) >= 15,
          "Gate G3 requires at least 15 gauges inside the utilisation window")
nb_assert(all(sel$rho >= P$rho_window[1] & sel$rho <= P$rho_window[2]),
          "a selected gauge lies outside the utilisation window")
print(sel[, .N, by = basin][order(-N)])
```

`[assumption]` The command area is `f_irr * catchment area`, a Stage-A
envelope. Measured Stage-B irrigation demand was not available; the
`f_irr` sweep {0.03, 0.10, 0.25} carries this uncertainty into stage S8.
Every gauge's `area_source` string records the provenance so the assumption
cannot drift silently.

`[measurement]` The **same** `claim_m3` scales demand and supply for a gauge.
Area cancels from demand (demand is a depth rate), so a claim is a physical
volume of water over the command area, never a free constant.
